verdict.rationale: Bento says it maintains first-party SDK packages for JavaScript, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce, and Next.js, and the docs index advertises SDK references. Its agent guidance (Bento Skills) also names the SDK as one of the surfaces an agent should choose from. Missing for 10: detail on SDK depth and API coverage, SDKs for languages such as Python or Go, and independent or hands-on confirmation of SDK quality.
